title: scantor task manifest (scantor.yaml)
description: The manifest at the root of every task folder. Strict: unknown keys are rejected. Bind it in editors with the modeline `# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lonetis/scantor/v<version>/schemas/task-manifest.schema.json`. Semantic rules that JSON Schema cannot express (duration and size bounds, entry path rules, instance limits, privileged permission) are enforced by `scantor task check-static`; see docs/tasks.md.

scantor.description: Manifest format version. Always 1 for this schema.

name.description: Task name: a slug unique per owner, equal to the workspace folder name and immutable once the task exists. Not a uuid and not a reserved word.

language.description: Task language: a key of schemas/languages.json. It selects the base image (SCANTOR_BASE) and the default entry.

description.description: One-paragraph human description shown in the UI, CLI and MCP.

entry.description: Entry point. python/typescript/javascript: the source file that defines the task, relative to the image working directory (/task) and present in the task folder. go: the path of the binary the Dockerfile builds. Defaults to languages.json `entry` (main.py, main.ts, main.js, /task/task).

duration.description: Duration as integer amounts with units ms, s, m, h (Go duration syntax without fractions), for example `30s`, `5m`, `1h30m`.

byteSize.description: Byte size: a non-negative integer with an optional binary suffix KiB, MiB, GiB or TiB, for example `512MiB`.

defaults.description: Default scan settings. Every value can be overridden per scan (settings of POST /api/scans) except `privileged`. Omitted values fall back to the platform fallbacks listed in docs/data-model.md §4.5.1.

workers.description: Runner workers (containers) per scan. Fallback 1. Upper bound: SCANTOR_MAX_WORKERS_PER_SCAN of the instance.

processes.description: Connector processes per worker. Fallback 1. Upper bound: SCANTOR_MAX_PROCESSES_PER_WORKER of the instance.

timeout.description: Per-analysis timeout (1s … 24h). Fallback 5m. Fixed for the lifetime of a scan.

maxAttempts.description: Attempts per analysis per round, including the first. Fallback 3.

backoff.description: Delay before attempt n+1: min(max, initial × factor^(n−1)); with jitter a uniform value in [delay/2, delay].

max.description: Upper bound of a delay (≥ initial, ≤ 24h). Fallback 10m.

jitter.description: Randomise each delay in [delay/2, delay]. Fallback true.

resources.description: Resources PER PROCESS. A worker container gets processes × cpus CPUs and processes × memory + 256 MiB memory.

memory.description: Memory per process (64MiB … 64GiB, whole MiB). Fallback 512MiB.

maxAnalysesPerProcess.description: Recycle a connector process after this many analyses. Fallback 1000.

privileged.description: Run workers with Docker-in-Docker (sysbox or privileged nodes only). Requires the owner's canRunPrivileged permission at publish and scan start. Fallback false. Not overridable per scan.

examples.name: origins-http
examples.description: Fetch the landing page of every origin of a CrUX top list.
